title: Software Engineer II · Full-time
highlights: Delivered 8–9 B2B SaaS digital transformation implementations across pharma, food, biofuels, campus utilities, and chemicals; owned technical discovery, solution architecture, integration design, UAT/validation, go-live, training, and hypercare.

Led onsite discovery and configuration workshops with operators and stakeholders; produced process maps, solution architecture diagrams, Jira backlogs, phased rollout plans, and acceptance criteria across 6–8 stakeholder groups.

Owned the full feature lifecycle for custom MES requests by gathering user and business requirements, defining scope and success criteria, coordinating build work, and driving testing/UAT through release.

Built TypeScript/JavaScript and Python functions for Augmentir field-operator workflows, implementing issue/action/suggestion routing logic, UI-triggered behaviors, validation rules, and tested decision-support flows.
Wrote 20–55 unit tests per Augmentir function across happy-path, positive, negative, and edge-case scenarios to validate routing behavior, operator inputs, and workflow outcomes before release.

Built chat-based SME-level agents in Augmentir for frontline operators; structured domain knowledge, engineered prompt templates, tested response quality, refined guardrails, and iterated with operator feedback.

Integrated Shiftconnector, Augmentir, GoCanvas, and AspenTech Inmation with SAP/ERP, CMMS, historians, alarms/events, and equipment logs using REST/JSON APIs, endpoint configuration, Postman testing, log analysis, and data validation.

Installed and administered Microsoft SQL Server for Shiftconnector; configured databases and wrote T-SQL export/reporting queries using joins, date filters, and aggregations across user entries and time periods.

Automated deployment and configuration workflows with Python and PowerShell, including parameterized scripts, data transformations, validation checks, structured logging, error handling, and repeatable bulk configuration/data movement.

Served as first-line post-go-live support for multi-site 30–100+ user deployments; triaged SSO, API, workflow, reporting, and data issues by reproducing failures, inspecting logs/payloads, validating data paths, isolating root causes, documenting fixes in runbooks, and leading admin/end-user trainings for 30–40 participants.
